steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tint the sky with a little yellow ochre
steps.load: tiny bit of yellow ochre

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: throw in small lavender shapes
steps.load: a little alizarin crimson with a touch of prussian blue
steps.rule: lavender stays clean over yellow instead of turning bright green

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap greenish background bushes with the corner
steps.load: greenish mix from black, ochre and white
steps.rule: layers of trees make a scene feel deep in the woods

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin tree trunks with the liner
steps.load: bush mix thinned with paint thinner, brown added

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: highlight the bushes with yellow ochre and crimson
steps.load: black with ochre and crimson, a bit more ochre

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: block in a closer tree with a darker mix
steps.load: darker version of the same mix
steps.rule: varying the color gives the feeling of depth

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: draw a big tree trunk with an arm
steps.load: van dyke brown thinned with paint thinner
steps.where: a big tree in the area

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: highlight the tree edge with bright red
steps.load: bright red mixed on the liner
steps.motion: tap a highlight on the edge
steps.rule: makes the little tree stand out and shine

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab dirty green highlights on the tree
steps.load: dirty green from black, ochre and crimson

steps.subject: land
steps.action: fill the bottom area with dark brown and black
steps.load: brown and black on the brush
steps.rule: pushing it in fills the bottom quickly

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap dark dirty green grass highlights
steps.load: dark green from the yellows and dark mix

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a basic barn shape
steps.load: scrape
steps.where: scraping lays out the shape without committing and clears paint for layers

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in the barn shape with brown
steps.load: roll of brown on the knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add a protrusion on the other side
steps.load: brown roll on the knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: color the barn with dulled reds and browns
steps.load: red, sienna and brown mixed
steps.rule: dulled so the painting is not too bright

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: bounce the knife for old roof shingles
steps.load: dark sienna with a little white

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: highlight the weathered boards with the knife
steps.load: dark sienna and white on the knife
steps.rule: to make the boards look old and weathered

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: darken the shadow side of the barn
steps.load: brown mix with the same color
steps.rule: a shadow under the edge makes it read right

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: cut the bottom off and add board marks
steps.load: brown on the knife
steps.motion: cut across then add board marks
steps.where: bottom of the barn and its face

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: layer grass with yellow tones
steps.load: greens from the dark mix plus yellows
steps.rule: keeps the foreground subdued so it is not too bright

steps.subject: path
steps.action: drag brown across the old path
steps.load: brown on the knife

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: paint a fence post with the small knife
steps.load: small roll of brown

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: pull fence rails with brown and white
steps.load: brown and white on the knife

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint big tree trunk with a light side
steps.load: brown with white on one side
steps.motion: draw trunk and light one side
steps.rule: big trees push everything back and make it deeper

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab dark leaves on the big tree
